map.失业率（本页代码口径）：u=失业人数÷劳动力总数×100（%）；联动量：就业人数: Unemployment rate (this page's code basis): u = unemployed ÷ total labor force × 100 (%); linked values: employed = labor force − unemployed, employment rate = (labor force − unemployed) ÷ (labor force||1) × 100 (%, the denominator falls back to 1 when 0), employment-rate complement = 100 − u (%). Validation: both fields are required valid numbers via the input guard, otherwise a prompt stops the run. Criteria: no fixed grading; the unemployment and employment rates are complements summing to 100%.
